user.title: generac

data.email: MobileLink username (optional — leave blank for cookie-paste mode)

user.description: Provide either username + password (auto-login) or paste a session cookie. Auto-login requires curl_cffi (~30-60s one-time install on first use). Need help? See github.com/binarydev/ha-generac.

data.auth_password: MobileLink password (leave blank to keep existing)

reconfigure.description: To switch back to paste-only mode, paste a fresh session cookie and leave the password blank — stored credentials will be wiped.

data.auth_password: MobileLink password (leave blank to keep existing)

reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. Re-enter your MobileLink password or paste a fresh cookie.

error.internal: Internal error testing credentials. File an issue at github.com/binarydev/ha-generac.
error.bad_credentials: Email or password rejected by Auth0.
error.imperva_block: Imperva blocked the login. Try a newer Chrome impersonation profile in Options, or paste a cookie manually for now.
error.curl_cffi_install_failed: Auto-login unavailable on this platform: failed to install curl_cffi. Paste a session cookie instead.
error.password_required_for_email: Password is required when email is set.
error.need_creds_or_cookie: Provide either email + password or a session cookie.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.

data.impersonate_profile: curl_cffi Chrome impersonation profile (e.g. chrome120, chrome124)

curl_cffi_unavailable.title: Generac auto-login unavailable
curl_cffi_unavailable.description: curl_cffi could not be installed in this Home Assistant Python environment, so auto-login is disabled for this entry. The integration is using the last-known session cookie. Paste a fresh cookie via Reconfigure when the current one expires.

imperva_block.title: Generac auto-login blocked by Imperva
imperva_block.description: Imperva is blocking the Generac auto-login flow (current Chrome impersonation profile: `{profile}`). Open Options for this integration and try a newer profile (e.g. `chrome124`), or paste a session cookie manually via Reconfigure. See `scripts/README.md` for the available profiles.
